request.recipient: Intersect via the 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Intersect's governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, release coordination, repository management, security initiatives, operations, ecosystem coordination, and management of critical processes for June 2026 to June 2027.

claims.claim: Intersect says the proposal funds its core operating model for June 2026 to June 2027, including governance coordination, reserved capacity for critical unowned processes, technical stewardship, incident response, and release coordination.
Intersect states the ask is reduced from last year's $7.875M to $6.35M while preserving the functions it considers most critical to Cardano continuity and maturity.
Intersect says it has coordinated two network upgrades, is preparing for a third, and led ecosystem coordination during the November 2025 chain partition incident.

The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and therefore advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal asserts the requested amount does not, at submission time, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

The budget allocates 6,000,000 ADA to Intersect operations and ecosystem coordination, 18,800,000 ADA to technical stewardship and incident response, and 600,000 ADA to management of critical processes.
The document discloses that Intersect and its committees received 22,385,000 ADA from three prior treasury withdrawal governance actions within the past 24 months.
Independent audits and assurance for this proposal are to be provided by Appold, with possible reviews of deliverables, controls, spend validation, and milestone evidence.

Intersect will use a Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, one Project-Specific Smart Contract, stated addresses, stated multisignature-style approval thresholds, and an external oversight committee of six entities.
The proposal says a public dashboard and on-chain records will allow the community to audit the TRSC and PSSC and track metrics related to the withdrawn ADA.

summary: The document requests 25,400,000 ADA for Intersect's 2026-2027 operating, governance coordination, technical stewardship, incident response, and critical-process functions, with budget line items, prior funding disclosure, voting and NCL assertions, smart-contract fund management details, references, and planned audit/assurance oversight.
